Below is a **complete, production‑ready skeleton** for a Trucking Transportation Management System (TMS) written in **Python 3.11+** using:

| Layer | Technology | Why |
|-------|------------|-----|
| Web API | **FastAPI** | Modern async framework, automatic docs (Swagger/OpenAPI), great performance |
| ORM / DB | **SQLAlchemy 2.0** + **PostgreSQL** | Mature, async support, ACID guarantees |
| Auth | **JWT** + **OAuth2PasswordBearer** | Stateless, secure, easy to integrate with mobile/web clients |
| Background jobs | **Celery + Redis** | Handles long‑running tasks (routing, ETA calculations, notifications) |
| Containerization | **Docker** + **docker‑compose** | Reproducible deployments |
| Testing | **pytest** + **httpx** | Async test client, coverage |
| CI/CD | **GitHub Actions** (example) | Automated linting, tests, image build |

> **NOTE** – The code below is intentionally modular so you can drop it into a repo, run `docker‑compose up`, and have a working API.  
> Feel free to extend each module (e.g., add more fields, business rules, external integrations).

---

### 2.1 `app/config.py`

```python
from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    DATABASE_URL: str = Field(..., env="DATABASE_URL")
    SECRET_KEY: str = Field(..., env="SECRET_KEY")
    ALGORITHM: str = "HS256"
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30
    REDIS_URL: str = Field("redis://localhost:6379/0", env="REDIS_URL")

settings = Settings()
```

```python
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from .models import Base
from ..config import settings

engine = create_async_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, future=True, echo=False)

async_session = sessionmaker(
    engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False
)

async def get_db():
    async with async_session() as session:
```

### 2.3 `app/db/models.py`

```python
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Boolean, ForeignKey, Float, DateTime
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, declarative_base
import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String, unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    hashed_password = Column(String, nullable=False)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.datetime.utcnow)

class Driver(Base):
    __tablename__ = "drivers"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    license_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)
    phone = Column(String, nullable=False)
    truck_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("trucks.id"))
    truck = relationship("Truck", back_populates="driver")

class Truck(Base):
    __tablename__ = "trucks"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    plate_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)
    capacity_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    driver = relationship("Driver", uselist=False, back_populates="truck")

class Shipment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "shipments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    description = Column(String, nullable=False)
    weight_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    origin_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    origin_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    dest_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    dest_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    status = Column(String, default="pending")  # pending, assigned, in_transit, delivered
    assigned_truck_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("trucks.id"), nullable=True)
    assigned_driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id"), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.datetime.utcnow)
```

### 2.5 `app/auth/utils.py`

```python
from passlib.context import CryptContext

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)
```

### 2.6 `app/auth/oauth2.py`

```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from jose import jwt, JWTError
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from ..config import settings
from ..db.session import get_db
from ..db.crud import get_user_by_email
from ..db.schemas import TokenData

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.utcnow() + (expires_delta if expires_delta else timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES))
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=settings.ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)):
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[settings.ALGORITHM])
        email: str = payload.get("sub")
        if email is None:
            raise credentials_exception
        token_data = TokenData(email=email)
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception
    async for user in get_user_by_email(email=token_data.email):
        return user
    raise credentials_exception
```

### 2.7 `app/db/crud.py`

```python
from sqlalchemy.future import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from .session import async_session
from .models import User, Driver, Truck, Shipment
from .schemas import UserCreate, DriverCreate, TruckCreate, ShipmentCreate
from ..auth.utils import hash_password, verify_password
from typing import AsyncGenerator

# ---------- USER ----------
async def get_user_by_email(email: str) -> AsyncGenerator[User, None]:
    async with async_session() as session:
        result = await session.execute(select(User).where(User.email == email))
        user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if user:
            yield user

async def create_user(user_in: UserCreate):
    async with async_session() as session:
        new_user = User(email=user_in.email, hashed_password=hash_password(user_in.password))
        session.add(new_user)
        try:
            await session.commit()
            await session.refresh(new_user)
            return new_user
        except IntegrityError:
            await session.rollback()
            raise ValueError("Email already registered")

# ---------- DRIVER ----------
async def create_driver(driver_in: DriverCreate):
    async with async_session() as session:
        new_driver = Driver(**driver_in.dict())
        session.add(new_driver)
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(new_driver)
        return new_driver

# ---------- TRUCK ----------
async def create_truck(truck_in: TruckCreate):
    async with async_session() as session:
        new_truck = Truck(**truck_in.dict())
        session.add(new_truck)
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(new_truck)
        return new_truck

# ---------- SHIPMENT ----------
async def create_shipment(shipment_in: ShipmentCreate):
    async with async_session() as session:
        new_shipment = Shipment(**shipment_in.dict())
        session.add(new_shipment)
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(new_shipment)
        return new_shipment

async def assign_shipment(shipment_id: int, truck_id: int, driver_id: int):
    async with async_session() as session:
        result = await session.execute(select(Shipment).where(Shipment.id == shipment_id))
        shipment = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not shipment:
            raise ValueError("Shipment not found")
        shipment.assigned_truck_id = truck_id
        shipment.assigned_driver_id = driver_id
        shipment.status = "assigned"
        await session.commit()
        await session.refresh(shipment)
        return shipment
```

### 2.8 `app/routes/users.py`

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from ..db.crud import create_user, get_user_by_email
from ..db.schemas import UserCreate, UserOut, Token, TokenData
from ..auth.oauth2 import create_access_token, get_current_user
from ..auth.utils import verify_password
from datetime import timedelta
from ..config import settings

router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["users"])

@router.post("/register", response_model=UserOut)
async def register(user_in: UserCreate):
    try:
        user = await create_user(user_in)
        return user
    except ValueError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))

@router.post("/token", response_model=Token)
async def login(form_data: UserCreate):
    async for user in get_user_by_email(email=form_data.email):
        if verify_password(form_data.password, user.hashed_password):
            access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
            access_token = create_access_token(
                data={"sub": user.email}, expires_delta=access_token_expires
            )
            return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"}
    raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Incorrect email or password")

@router.get("/me", response_model=UserOut)
async def read_me(current_user: UserOut = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return current_user
```

### 2.12 `app/main.py`

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from .routes import users, drivers, trucks, shipments
from .db.session import engine, Base
import asyncio

app = FastAPI(title="Trucking TMS API")

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    # Create tables on first run
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)

app.include_router(users.router)
app.include_router(drivers.router)
app.include_router(trucks.router)
app.include_router(shipments.router)
```

```python
import pytest

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_create_shipment(async_client):
    # First, register & login
    await async_client.post("/users/register", json={
        "email": "bob@example.com",
        "password": "secret123"
    })
    resp = await async_client.post("/users/token", data={
        "email": "bob@example.com",
        "password": "secret123"
    })
    token = resp.json()["access_token"]

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Create shipment
    resp = await async_client.post("/shipments/", json={
        "description": "Electronics",
        "weight_tons": 5.0,
        "origin_lat": 40.7128,
        "origin_lon": -74.0060,
        "dest_lat": 34.0522,
        "dest_lon": -118.2437
    }, headers=headers)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["status"] == "pending"
```
